posture.play: Decision zone — stay balanced. Hold benchmark weight and avoid big bets; this is where the next regime is decided. Let the Intermediate dial lead, not the headlines.

master.head: HOLD · BENCHMARK
master.action: Hold benchmark weights and wait for the Intermediate dial to break out of the ±20 band.

tilts.name: QUALITY
tilts.text: Tilt to quality and low leverage

flags.text: VIX 33.0 is above its long-run mean + 1σ. See the playbook for historical forward returns.
